We Are Hiring – Business Analyst (BA) / Business Development Executive (BDE) | Dubai, UAE
🚀 Excellent Webworld is looking for skilled professionals to join its Dubai team!
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💼 Experience: 2+ Years
**Open Positions:**
🔹 Business Analyst (BA)
🔹 Business Development Executive (BDE)
**Key Requirements:**
- Relevant BA or BDE experience
- Strong communication skills
- Business analysis and documentation (BA)
- Client relationships and business development (BDE)
- Strong coordination and problem-solving abilities
⭐ Immediate joiners preferred.
⭐ Candidates currently based in Dubai will receive preference.
📩 **How to Apply:**
Send your updated resume to: https://lnkd.in/dWWPYUfs
🚫 Do NOT send CVs via LinkedIn DM
✅ Click on the job link
✅ Click Apply Now on the website
📧 You will see the official HR email
📩 Send your CV directly to the email above.
👉 For fast job updates, join our WhatsApp channel here:

posts.content:
🚀 WE ARE HIRING | QA ANALYST | DUBAI, UAE
We are looking for an experienced QA Analyst to join our team for an exciting onsite opportunity in Dubai.
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💼 Experience: 4+ Years
🏢 Work Mode: Onsite
Key Requirements:
4+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Testing.
Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
Experience in preparing and executing test cases and test scenarios.
Knowledge of Functional, Regression, Integration and UAT Testing.
Ability to identify, document, track and report defects.
Good understanding of defect management and QA processes.
Strong analytical and communication skills.
📩 Interested candidates: Share your updated resume via DM or email.
Know someone who might be a good fit? Feel free to tag or refer them!
